description: React Native component for a language selection modal, allowing users to choose and change app language with persistence and reload.

classes.name: LanguageModal
classes.description: React component for language selection modal with language persistence and app reload.

methods.name: selectLanguage
methods.description: Loads saved language preferences from storage and updates state accordingly.

methods.name: onSelectedLanguage
methods.description: Saves selected language to storage, updates app language, shows reload message, and reloads app.

methods.name: handleClose
methods.description: Closes the modal unless 'dontClose' prop is true.
